EC1: - Deterioration of neurological symptomatology within 60 day before enrollment ;
EC2: - Changes brought to the multiple sclerosis treatment within 6 months before enrollment ;
EC3: - Introduction of a treatment acting on spasticity [OR] or fatigue within 30 day before enrollment
EC4: - Changes brought to reeducation protocol throughout the duration of the study
EC5: - Patient [NOT] unable to provide an effort equivalent to 3 times the resting metabolic value = 3 Metabolic Equivalent of Task (METs).
